findings.title: Resend POST abuse posture (AD-15 fake-success) handler branch is unpinned — answer POST bot path IS tested, resend is not
findings.evidence: handle_resend: 'case application_handler.is_honeypot_filled(values) || is_resend_timing_suspicious(values) { True -> form_pages.view_resent() |> ssr_response.to_sensitive_response'. Every resend integration test calls handle_resend with timing_fields() where _website="" (empty); the answer-path bot branches ARE pinned (honeypot_filled_post_saves_nothing_test, missing_timing_post_saves_nothing_test) but resend is not. is_resend_timing_suspicious is unit-tested but the handler fake-success-without-remint wiring is never executed.
findings.detail: AC6 pins the abuse posture on both answer AND resend POSTs. The honeypot guard defends token remint; a regression dropping it would let bots trigger remints and pass CI.
findings.recommended_fix: Mirror honeypot_filled_post_saves_nothing_test for POST /reference/:token/resend: fill _website, assert 200 + data-testid=reference-resent AND form_token unchanged + no audit row.

findings.title: Complete-draft GET dispatching the review screen is untested at the handler level (the W1 fix's server-side target)
findings.evidence: form_handler: '_, None, None -> form_pages.view_review(vars:, token:, entries: review_entries(slot, draft, vars))'. No integration test seeds a complete draft and GETs the bare /reference/:token URL asserting the review screen. reopen_resumes_at_next_unanswered_test seeds a PARTIAL draft (next=relationship) and asserts landing-absent + data-current on relationship — the resume case, not the complete-draft review case. view_review is unit-tested in form_pages_test but the handler dispatch is unpinned end-to-end.
findings.detail: The complete-draft -> review-screen GET dispatch (the destination of W1's desktop nav fix) lacks an integration pin; a regression rerouting it would pass CI. view_review render itself is covered.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an integration test filling every draft key for a slot, GET /reference/:token, assert data-testid=reference-review renders.

findings.title: form_handler.get_value duplicates application_handler.get_form_value, omitting the trim
findings.evidence: form_handler.get_value: 'case list.key_find(values, name) { Ok(v) -> v; Error(_) -> "" }' (no trim). application_handler.get_form_value:2319: 'case list.key_find(values, key) { Ok(value) -> string.trim(value); Error(_) -> "" }'. application_handler is already imported (form_handler.gleam:20).
findings.detail: Drift hazard: the local copy silently omits the trim. Harmless today (call sites read ids + epoch-ms, not free text), but a fork that can diverge.
findings.recommended_fix: Delete form_handler.get_value; route its 3 call sites (lines 319, 353, 910) through application_handler.get_form_value.

findings.title: questions.question_count is orphan dead code (form_handler inlines list.length(all_questions) instead)
findings.evidence: questions.gleam:346 'pub fn question_count(slot) -> Int { questions_for(slot) |> list.length }'. Zero call sites: form_handler.gleam:161 computes the landing count inline as 'question_count: list.length(all_questions)'. The 'question_count' record field (form_pages.gleam:83) and form_copy.landing_meta param are unrelated to this function.
findings.detail: Violates AGENTS.md No-Technical-Debt. Every other pub fn in the module is referenced; this one is not.
findings.recommended_fix: Delete the function, or replace list.length(all_questions) in form_handler:161 with questions.question_count(slot).

findings.title: Resend rollback conflates Ok(0-row) with success in a concurrent-takeover race; retry form can strand on a dead old_token
findings.evidence: rollback_remint: 'case sql.restore_form_token(...) { Ok(_) -> Nil; Error(err) -> wisp.log_error(...) }'. restore_form_token.sql guard: 'WHERE form_token = $1 AND status = \'contact_initiated\' AND taken_over_at IS NULL'. A takeover/terminal transition mid-send-window yields 0 rows (Ok, not Error); the caller then renders view_resend_failed(token: old_token) whose retry form points at the now-dead old_token.
findings.detail: Narrow concurrent race (takeover lands between remint and rollback). Outcome is a 404 on retry (truthful-ish copy), not data loss. AD-14 discipline relies on re-classifying on 0 rows.
findings.recommended_fix: Match Ok(pog.Returned(_, [])) separately in rollback_remint; on 0 rows re-classify and render the truthful state page instead of the resend-failed retry form.

findings.title: Resend POST form is duplicated verbatim in view_expired and view_resend_failed (differ only in testids + label)
findings.evidence: Both render an identical structure: html.form([method POST, action /reference/<token>/resend, novalidate, data-testid], [view_honeypot_field, view_timing_field, html.button([submit, btn-submit, data-testid], [text label])]). Differs only in form testid (reference-resend-form vs -retry-form), button testid, and label constant (expired_resend_button vs resend_failed_retry_button). ~18 lines duplicated.
findings.detail: AGENTS.md DRY rule: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places. A future change to the resend form must touch both.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract private view_resend_form(token, button_label, form_testid, button_testid); both views pass their distinct testids + label.

findings.title: is_expired (<=) and remint_form_token guard (<) disagree at the exact expiry boundary
findings.evidence: get_form_context: '(rc.form_token_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND rc.form_token_expires_at <= now())::text AS is_expired'. remint guard: 'AND form_token_expires_at < now()'. save_draft_answer uses '> now()' (the correct complement of <=). At expires_at == now(), is_expired=TRUE (renders expired + resend offer) but remint guard=FALSE.
findings.detail: Theoretical ms-boundary inconsistency. Unreachable in practice: the expired GET already had expires_at <= now(), and human click latency pushes the resend POST's now() strictly past expiry, so remint succeeds. resend is gated on classify_row==ExpiredOpen. Code-smell only.
findings.recommended_fix: Align operators: make remint_form_token's guard <= now() to match is_expired, or change is_expired to < now().

findings.title: ChoiceWithOther 'other' text field rendered but never pinned; no end-to-end POST of an 'other' answer
findings.evidence: The landlord 'relationship' question is ChoiceWithOther; the reveal field a_<id>_other renders in the all-questions test but no assertion pins name="a_relationship_other", and no integration test POSTs relationship='other' with other-text.
findings.detail: A regression deleting the view_text_field call for the 'other' reveal would pass every c3 test.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin name="a_relationship_other" in the render test + one integration POST of an 'other' answer asserting the _other draft key persists.

findings.title: ?q=<answered-id> pre-fill GET dispatch only unit-tested (clamp_current), not integration-pinned

findings.recommended_fix: Add an integration test GETting /reference/:token?q=<answered-question-id> asserting the saved answer pre-fills + current marker on that question.

findings.title: Resend guarded-write 0-row stand-down (AD-14) branch untested

findings.title: clamp_current last_question_id fallback branch is masked by its own dedicated test
findings.evidence: clamp_all_answered_targets_the_last_question_test calls clamp_current(LandlordRef, Some("free_text"), all_keys, None). 'free_text' is a valid answered id, so the case hits branch 'True, Some(id), _ -> id' (form_handler.gleam:266), never the '_, _, None -> last_question_id(slot)' fallback (line 269).
findings.detail: The test claims to pin the fallback but cannot fail if last_question_id regresses.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a case with an invalid/None q_param when all keys answered, e.g. clamp_current(LandlordRef, Some("bogus"), all_keys, None), asserting it equals the last question id.

findings.title: resend_audit_details no-PII assertions are vacuous (fixture detail carries no PII)
findings.evidence: The ChannelOutcome fixture details ('email-id', 'twilio not configured') contain neither '@' nor '+353', so the should.be_false assertions for '@'/'+353' pass even if a regression appends o.detail to the audit JSON.
findings.detail: The audit_log row shape is a load-bearing compliance contract; the no-PII guard is untestable as written.
findings.recommended_fix: Use a PII-bearing fixture detail (e.g. 'recipient@example.com' / '+353861234567') so the absence assertions become load-bearing against a detail-leak regression.
